evidence.root: Re-review at bcd59fc (5,899 bytes): git diff 5408fee bcd59fc changes only two root lines. Step 6 again says a missing platform subsection does not prove 'support, nonapplicability or identical behavior'. Adapt again says 'Change the supplied artifact, or give an explicit before and after contract when a specification is requested'. Both restore rules of b1c4ce8. From the first review: description of 750 characters, third person, under 1,024, and its 'Do not use for' sentence keeps 'unless the question is about the user interface', so real UI work is not excluded. Platform, device and task intake asks only when needed and keeps the framework and product requirements. Web, Android and Windows go first to beyond-apple/README.md. The topic index is searched as text for concepts and component names. Getting started is read for each target platform for new surfaces, platform support or platform changes. One owning procedure is read per material decision, and a nearby reminder does not replace it. A review maps each control even when its code is missing, and missing evidence does not prove a defect. The source guide gives exact rules. The four modes are present (design, implement, review with ranked source-backed findings and no invented violations, adapt). The reporting rules (official links, qualifiers, units and scope, conflicts, passed/failed/not done, static-evidence limits) and the source limits are kept. Remaining differences from the old root are editorial: the media link is in the index footer, the caution that a local file is not proof of review was removed, and the caution that reading or citing is not runtime proof is shortened to the static-evidence sentence. None of them changes the route.
evidence.families: git diff b1c4ce8 shows no change to the 13 family SKILL.md files, and the recorded family hashes match. A script confirmed that each family file links every procedure in its .topics folder exactly once (4+18+9+13+10+12+5+25+8+11+4+10+29 = 158). I read the Status family in full and spot-read others: each family still makes its domain choice and sends the reader to the exact topic procedure before its guide. The new root makes families optional ('only to compare the topics of one area') and links all 13 with correct paths. No family depends on the family table that the old root removed. The family sentence 'load related topics only when the chosen procedure calls for them' is narrower than the root rule 'one procedure for each material decision'. This tension existed before the change, and the root rule governs.

evidence.scope_limits: The root says that the package is independent of Apple, comes from a dated English snapshot and is local guidance, not a verbatim manual or an SDK reference. It names the unavailable pages and the libraries outside the source. Non-Apple guidance is reached only through beyond-apple/README.md and the platforms row, and both are marked 'Not from Apple HIG'. The description claims web, Android and Windows use only when such an app 'must follow Apple-style design'. This review approves the route, the index mapping and the platform routes. It does not approve the content of the authored files (beyond-apple, key-numbers, commands, agent; see coverage/authored-reviews.json), the generated implementation map, client auto-discovery, benchmark behavior or results on Apple hardware.
